# git: alias: refactor alias.configure and alias.aliases

Part of [[DOT-354]]: move `configure` (runs [git_config](../../bin/git_config) itself) and `aliases` (pretty-prints the alias list through the `git_aliases` Python script, [[DOT-19]]) into a new `bin/lib/git/init.bash`, and decide whether `aliases` is worth keeping. Action items to plan alongside: the config-based flow [[DOT-173]], the `git` proxy [[DOT-135]], rethinking aliases with external tools [[DOT-138]].
